# kits/characters: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

Characters: MakeHuman (MPFB2) bodies with morphing face, build and ancestry; library clothes, hair and beards that follow the morphs; skin and hair tint; peoples (data/peoples.json) that keep a culture's strangers in range; an editor page and a Godot twin (godot/krator/character/, behind).

Build: `cd kits/characters && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
